sentence: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُرْسِلَ email إِلَى الْمُدِيرِ الْآن
raw: أريد أن أرسل email إلى المدير الآن
ipa: ʔuˈriːdu ˈʔan ˈʔursila imiːl ˈʔilaː lmuˈdiːr aˈlʔaːn
gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] email→imiːl (donor /iː/ into MSA 3-vowel set); MSA news-register frame أريد/الآن (ryding2005). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: عِنْدِي meeting مُهِمٌّ مَعَ manager الْيَوْمَ
raw: عندي meeting مهم مع manager اليوم
ipa: ˈʕindiː miːtink muˈhimmun ˈmaʕa manadʒar aˈljawm
gloss_en: I have an important meeting with a manager today
notes: [work] meeting→miːtink: final /ŋ/→[nk] — MSA has no /ɡ/, so the [nɡ] reflex projects to nearest [nk] (total projection, translit.py _project); manager→manadʒar, loan /dʒ/ kept (no /ʒ/ in MSA). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: أَعْلَنَتِ الشَّرِكَةُ عَنْ offer جَدِيدٍ وَ discount كَبِيرٍ
raw: أعلنت الشركة عن offer جديد و discount كبير
ipa: ʔaˈʕlanati ˈʃʃarika ˈʕan ufar dʒaˈdiːdin ˈwa disawnt kaˈbiːrin
gloss_en: the company announced a new offer and a big discount
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; discount→disawnt (/aʊ/→[aw]). Formal MSA matrix (watson2002). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: لَا بُدَّ مِنْ عَمَلِ update لِلْبَرْنَامَجِ الْآن
raw: لا بد من عمل update للبرنامج الآن
ipa: ˈlaː ˈbudda ˈmin ˈʕamali abdat lilbaˈrnaːmadʒi ˈlʔaːn
gloss_en: an update must be done for the program now
notes: [tech] update→abdat (/p/→[b], /eɪ/-free). MSA frame لا بد من (ryding2005). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: شَاهَدْتُ video طَوِيلًا عَلَى الْإِنْتَرْنِت online
raw: شاهدت video طويلا على الإنترنت online
ipa: ʃaˈːhadtu fidiu tˤɑˈwijlan ˈʕalaː lʔiˈntarnit unlin
gloss_en: I watched a long video online on the internet
notes: [media] video→fidiu (/v/→[f], watson2002); online→unlin (/aɪ/→[aj]). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: نَسِيتُ password الْبَرِيدِ email مَرَّةً أُخْرَى
raw: نسيت password البريد email مرة أخرى
ipa: naˈsiːtu baswuːrd albaˈriːd imiːl ˈmarratan ˈʔuxraː
gloss_en: I forgot the email password again
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b]); email→imiːl. Standard MSA business register. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: لَا أَعْرِفُ لَكِنِّي think أَنَّ هَذَا project مُكَلِّفٌ
raw: لا أعرف لكني think أن هذا project مكلف
ipa: ˈlaː ˈʔaʕrifu laˈkinniː θink ˈʔanna ˈhaːðaː brudʒikt muˈkallifun
gloss_en: I don't know but I think this project is costly
notes: [work] think→θink — /θ/ KEPT, MSA declares the interdental (unlike Cairene [tink]); project→brudʒikt (/p/→[b]). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: سَيَصِلُ delivery غَدًا وَالدَّفْعُ cash
raw: سيصل delivery غدا والدفع cash
ipa: saˈjasˤilu dilifari ˈɣadan waˈːlddafʕ kaʃ
gloss_en: the delivery arrives tomorrow and payment is cash
notes: [commerce] delivery→dilifari (initial-position switch); cash→kaʃ (/æ/→[a]). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: الْخِدْمَةُ service لَيْسَتْ جَيِّدَةً وَالتَّوْصِيلُ delivery مُتَأَخِّرٌ
raw: الخدمة service ليست جيدة والتوصيل delivery متأخر
ipa: aˈlxidma sarfis ˈlajsat dʒaˈjjidatan waːlttaˈwsˤiːl dilifari mutaˈʔaxxirun
gloss_en: the service is not good and the delivery is late
notes: [commerce] service→sarfis (/v/→[f]); delivery→dilifari. MSA negator ليست (ryding2005). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: اِشْتَرَيْتُ laptop جَدِيدًا لَكِنَّ wifi بَطِيءٌ
raw: اشتريت laptop جديدا لكن wifi بطيء
ipa: iʃtaˈrajtu labtub dʒaˈdiːdan laˈkinna wifi bɑˈtˤiːʔun
gloss_en: I bought a new laptop but the wifi is slow
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b]); wifi→wifi (all-native segments). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: أَرْسِلْ لِي link عَلَى message
raw: أرسل لي link على message
ipa: ˈʔarsil ˈliː link ˈʕalaː misadʒ
gloss_en: send me the link on a message
notes: [tech] link→link; message→misadʒ (loan /dʒ/ kept). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: سَنَجْتَمِعُ فِي weekend الْقَادِمِ إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: سنجتمع في weekend القادم إن شاء الله
ipa: sanaˈdʒtamiʕu ˈfiː wiːkind aˈlqaːdim ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: we will meet next weekend, God willing
notes: [daily] weekend→wiːkind (/iː/,/ɛ/→[i]). Formal MSA سنجتمع/القادم. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: الْأَخْبَارُ عَلَى الرَّادْيُو كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ
raw: الأخبار على الراديو كل صباح
ipa: alʔaˈxbaːr ˈʕalaː ˈrraːdjuː ˈkulla sˤɑˈbaːħin
gloss_en: the news on the radio every morning
notes: [media] loan راديو 'radio' → read natively; matches attested MSA [raːdjuː] (Wehr s.v.). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: تَصَفَّحْتُ الْإِنْتَرْنِت لِسَاعَةٍ كَامِلَةٍ
raw: تصفحت الإنترنت لساعة كاملة
ipa: tɑsˤɑˈffaħtu lʔiˈntarnit liˈsaːʕatin kaˈːmilatin
gloss_en: I browsed the internet for a whole hour
notes: [tech] loan إنترنت 'internet' → [ʔintarnit], matches attested MSA realization (Wehr; standard). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: أَصَابَ فَيْرُوس جَهَازَ الْحَاسُوبِ
raw: أصاب فيروس جهاز الحاسوب
ipa: ʔɑˈsˤɑːba faˈjruːs dʒaˈhaːza lħaˈːsuːb
gloss_en: a virus infected the computer
notes: [tech] loan فيروس 'virus' → [fajruːs] (/v/-loan written with ف), matches attested MSA. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: شَاهَدْنَا الْخَبَرَ عَلَى التِّلِفِزْيُون مَسَاءً
raw: شاهدنا الخبر على التلفزيون مساء
ipa: ʃaˈːhadnaː ˈlxabar ˈʕalaː ttilifizˈjoːn maˈsaːʔan
gloss_en: we watched the news on television in the evening
notes: [media] loan تلفزيون 'television'; attested MSA [tilifizˈjoːn] (و = loan mid vowel [oː], stress on penult) — pipeline reads و as [uː] and mis-stresses. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'ʃaˈːhadnaː ˈlxabar ˈʕalaː ttilifiˈzjuːn maˈsaːʔan'; correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: اِتَّصَلْتُ بِكَ عَلَى الْمُوبَايِل فَلَمْ تُجِبْ
raw: اتصلت بك على الموبايل فلم تجب
ipa: ittɑˈsˤɑltu ˈbika ˈʕalaː lmoˈbaːjil ˈfalam ˈtudʒib
gloss_en: I called you on the mobile but you did not answer
notes: [tech] loan موبايل 'mobile'; attested [moˈbaːjil] (و = loan mid vowel [o]) — pipeline reads و as [uː] and mis-places stress inside the length mark. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'ittɑˈsˤɑltu ˈbika ˈʕalaː lmuˈːbaːjil ˈfalam ˈtudʒib'; correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: ana 3ayez a2ollak 7aga muhimma
raw: ana 3ayez a2ollak 7aga muhimma
ipa: ˈʔanaː ʔuˈriːdu ˈʔan ʔaˈquːla ˈlaka ˈʃajʔan muˈhimman
gloss_en: I want to tell you something important
notes: [daily] Arabizi (3=ع, 7=ح, 2=hamza): spells أنا أريد أن أقول لك شيئا مهما. Pipeline has no Latin-as-Arabic path (translit never sniffs); ipa = the MSA reading of the spelt sentence. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: 3ala fekra el ijtima3 bokra
raw: 3ala fekra el ijtima3 bokra
ipa: ˈʕalaː ˈfikratin liaːdʒtiˈmaːʕ ˈɣadan
gloss_en: by the way the meeting is tomorrow
notes: [daily] Arabizi (3=ع): spells على فكرة الاجتماع غدا. unsupported (no Latin path); ipa = MSA reading of the spelt sentence. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: sho2ran 3ala el mosa3ada
raw: sho2ran 3ala el mosa3ada
ipa: ˈʃukran ˈʕalaː lmuˈsaːʕada
gloss_en: thank you for the help
notes: [daily] Arabizi (2=hamza→[ʔ], 3=ع): spells شكرا على المساعدة. unsupported; ipa = MSA reading of the spelt sentence. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)
